field.label: Description
field.help: Optional label to help identify this entry in the list.

field.label: IKE connection
field.help: One of your configured connections (VPN > IPsec > Connections), shown by its description.

field.label: Child SA
field.help: Any configured child SA, shown by its description. Make sure it actually belongs to the connection selected above - saving will warn you if it doesn't.

field.label: Downtime threshold (minutes)
field.help: How many consecutive minutes this tunnel must be down before the watchdog forces a reconnect.
